responses:
I wouldn't send the offer yet. The analysis gets clause 7.1 wrong, cites a clause 4.6 that isn't in the tender, and covers only 3 of the tender's 11 requirements. There's also no offer document in `tenders/T-2026-014/`, so I couldn't check any of the "our offer" values. They come only from the extraction agent.

## Problems with the three items it lists

| # | What the analysis says | What the tender says | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "7.1 requires 5 years" | 7.1: **24 months** from commissioning (`tender.md:29`) | **Wrong requirement.** A 5-year offer would still meet it, but the analysis misstates the tender. Also check that 5 years of warranty is what we actually mean to commit to. |
| 2 | "Paint to RAL 5015 (4.6)" | **There is no clause 4.6.** Section 4 ends at 4.5, and the tender says nothing about paint or RAL colour anywhere. | **Made-up citation.** Remove it, or find where the requirement really comes from (a separate spec or customer email?). Don't cite it as a tender clause. |
| 3 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1) | Matches 4.1 (`tender.md:17`) | The requirement is quoted correctly. But the offer is summarised as "400 V 50 Hz" without "3-phase", so confirm that. |

## Requirements the analysis leaves out

- **4.2:** IE3 minimum for all motors.
- **9.1 (overrides 4.2):** motors above 75 kW must be **IE4**. That means **P-01 (90 kW) needs IE4**. P-02 (37 kW) needs IE3.
- **4.3 + Annex B:** P-01 sits in the wet well, which is **Zone 1**, so its motor must be **ATEX Ex d certified**. P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous.
- **4.4:** power cables at least 2.5 mm².
- **4.5:** IP65 or better for panel and motor terminal enclosures.
- **7.4:** delivery within **16 weeks** of the purchase order. This is a **hard rejection criterion**: offers over 16 weeks are rejected.
- **9.2:** ambient design temperature of **50 °C**. This can affect motor derating and panel cooling.
- **9.3:** Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7.

## Before sending

The biggest risks are the IE4 and ATEX requirements for P-01 and the 16-week delivery limit. Any one of them could get the offer rejected or leave us liable for non-compliance. The analysis needs redoing against every clause, checked against the actual offer document. If you share the offer, I can do that check line by line.
